data.narrative:
Solar Foods is a public-stage biotech company in the Biotech & Health sector that has raised $160M+. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of four same-sector, same-stage comparables: Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B), Freenome ($1.1B), Alto Neuroscience ($1.0B), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M).

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. The median valuation across these four comps is $1.1B, with a range spanning $539M to $1.6B. This method directly reflects Solar Foods' positioning within an established cohort of public biotech companies. A public-comp anchoring approach using sector P/S multiples (7.4x median across three public tickers: RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue data, which is typical for private-stage biotech.

The triangulated valuation range is $910M (low), $1.1B (median), and $1.2B (high). This relatively narrow range reflects reliance on a single applicable method and suggests valuation sensitivity to peer selection and stage-specific performance metrics. Key uncertainties include the company's development-stage economics, pipeline probability of success, and the extent to which capital deployment efficiency differs from the peer median. Absent revenue or milestone data, precision beyond the $910M–$1.2B band is not supported by available inputs.
